title: Long before the World Cup, Ukrainian immigrants built a soccer powerhouse in Philly
summary: World Cup games are underway in Philadelphia. Long before Americans caught the world's soccer craze, Ukrainian migrants made Philly a soccer town. Today, the sport helps sustain their culture.
